title: Thrombosis risque prédiction Following Cast Immobilization (TRiP(cast)) score
abbreviations: Thrombosis Risk Prediction Following Cast Immobilization (TRiP(cast)) Score
formula:
The TRiP(cast) Score is calculated by the addition of the selected points:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Trauma 1 | Low-risk | 1 |
| Intermediate-risk | 2 | |
| High-risk | 3 | |
| Immobilization | Other cast or bracing with plantar support | 0 |
| Foot cast (ankle free) or any semi-rigid without plantar support | 1 | |
| Lower-leg cast | 2 | |
| Upper-leg cast | 3 | |
| Age, years | <35 years | 0 |
| ≥35 and <55 years | 1 | |
| ≥55 and <75 years | 2 | |
| ≥75 years | 3 | |
| Sex | Female | 0 |
| Male | 1 | |
| [BMI](nabda:calc.body-mass-index-bmi-body-surface-area-bsa\) , kg/m 2 | <25 kg/m 2 | 0 |
| ≥25 and <35 kg/m 2 | 1 | |
| ≥35 kg/m 2 | 2 | |
| Family history of VTE (first-degree relative) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |
| Personal history of VTE or known major thrombophilia | No | 0 |
| Yes | 4 | |
| Current use of oral contraceptives or estrogenic hormone therapy | No | 0 |
| Yes | 4 | |
| Cancer diagnosis within the past 5 years | No | 0 |
| Yes | 3 | |
| Pregnancy or puerperium | No | 0 |
| Yes | 3 | |
| Other immobilization within the past 3 months 2 | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |
| Surgery within the past 3 months | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |
| Comorbidity 3 | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Chronic venous insufficiency (varicose veins) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |

^1^Choose the most severe trauma.

**Low-risk trauma**

- Single malleolar ankle fracture.
- Patellar dislocation.
- (Meta)Tarsal bone(s) or forefoot fracture.
- Non-severe knee sprain or ankle sprain (grade 1 or 2).
- Significant muscle injury.

**Intermediate-risk trauma**

- Bi or trimalleolar ankle fracture.
- Patellar fracture.
- Ankle dislocation, Lisfranc injury.
- Severe knee sprain (with edema/hemarthrosis).
- Severe ankle sprain (grade 3).

**High-risk trauma**

- Fibula and/or tibia shaft fracture.
- Tibial plateau fracture.
- Achilles tendon rupture.

^2^Hospital admission, bedridden or flight >6 hours, and/or lower limb paralysis.

^3^Heart failure, rheumatoid arthritis, chronic kidney disease, COPD, and/or IBD.

**3-month risk of VTE, %** = [e^x^/(1+ e^x^)]*100,

where **x** = -6.677015 + 0.3332203*TRiP(cast) Score

how_to_use.why:
- While other models to predict VTE risk after lower limb trauma and immobilization exist, most are based on expert opinion or retrospective analysis.
- This score was derived with retrospective data and validated prospectively.
- Shown to decrease the rate of anticoagulation prescribing by 50% without showing an increase in the VTE rate in study population.
how_to_use.when:
- Utiliser cet outil pour déterminer le risque à 3 mois de VTE chez les patients adultes présentant un traumatisme des membres inférieurs nécessitant une immobilisation.
- Ne pas utiliser chez les patients pédiatriques ou chez ceux devant subir une chirurgie élective programmée.
how_to_use.pearls:
- A TRiP(cast) <7 = very low VTE risk (~0.2–0.9%) at 3 months.
- High NPV (~99%); useful to consider withholding prophylaxis in low-risk patients.
- Integrates trauma severity, immobilization, patient factors into one score.
- A high score should not equal automatic anticoagulation; even ≥7 has low absolute event rates (~2–3%). Bleeding risk, patient preference, and logistics should all be considered.

next_steps.management:
- Un score ≥7 suggère que le patient présente un risque élevé de TEV.
- Un traitement anticoagulant peut être envisagé chez ce patient, après s'être assuré qu'une discussion adéquate sur les risques et les bénéfices a été menée.

more_info:
Interpretation:

| TRiP(cast) Score | Risk of VTE |
| --- | --- |
| <7 | Low |
| ≥7 | High |
